settings.text: Hand-woven seagrass finished with the highest-quality leather. A structured top-handle silhouette, reimagined — and made in limited quantities.

settings.title: Details
settings.content:
Height: 9.5"  |  Width: 12"  |  Depth: 6"  |  Handle Drop: 4"

What it fits: phone, cardholder or slim wallet, sunglasses, compact, keys, and your daily essentials — structured for both day and evening.

settings.title: Delivery
settings.content:
Free shipping on all orders over $75. Once your order is placed, it ships and arrives within 7 to 10 business days.

Because each bag is woven by hand in limited quantities, sold-out colors may take 4 to 8 weeks to restock.

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for items in original, unused condition with all tags attached. Exchanges are always free.

settings.title: Care
settings.content:
Exterior: Hand-woven natural seagrass.
Handles & Trim: Highest-quality leather.

Care: Keep dry and store away from direct sunlight. Gently dust the seagrass with a soft, dry brush; wipe the leather trim with a clean, dry cloth and condition occasionally. Avoid prolonged moisture — natural fibers are durable but not waterproof.

settings.heading: Customize Your Straw Tote
settings.intro: Add an organizer, charm, or scarf to complete your bag — all designed to match.

settings.headline: Woven Entirely by Hand
settings.body:
Watch how the Straw Tote moves through the day. The hand-woven seagrass holds a structured shape whether the bag is full or empty. The leather handles sit easily in the hand or over the arm. It's the kind of piece that draws a second look — and a question about where you found it.

A classic shape, reimagined in natural straw. Refined enough for evening, easy enough for every day.

settings.heading: Two-Year Warranty
settings.body: Every Velantra bag is built to last. If anything fails in normal use, we’ll repair or replace it.

settings.headline: Hand-Woven Seagrass
settings.body: Natural seagrass, tightly woven for real structure and everyday durability. No two weaves are identical.

settings.headline: Leather Trim
settings.body: Top handles and edges finished in the highest-quality leather — hand-set, and made to age beautifully.

settings.headline: Made in Limited Runs
settings.body: Woven by hand in small quantities. When a color sells out, it can be weeks before it returns.

settings.headline: Clean, roomy interior
settings.body: Roomy enough for your essentials, refined enough for evening.

settings.headline: leather top handles
settings.body: Hand-set and finished at the edges. Made to soften with wear.

settings.headline: Hand-woven seagrass
settings.body: Tightly woven for a structure that holds well beyond the season.

settings.headline: A Classic Shape, Made by Hand in Straw
settings.body:
We took the structured top-handle silhouette that has defined luxury for decades and rebuilt it in hand-woven seagrass, finished with the highest-quality leather. Every panel is woven by hand and every edge is set by hand — so the bag you carry is genuinely one of a kind.

Made in limited quantities, it's designed to be the piece people ask about. Not a summer bag you pack away — a year-round statement that happens to be woven from straw.

settings.headline: Two years covered. Lifetime in our shop.
settings.body: Two-year warranty on materials and stitching. After that, we repair anything for the cost of materials. Send it back. Get it back better than you sent it.
